source: **{0}** fires once per request before rendering begins, for every render (streaming enabled or not). Read {1} to see whether streaming is possible for the route, and set {2} to force buffered rendering for this request, e.g. based on a cookie, auth state, or A/B bucket. The renderer streams only when {3}. This is the runtime escape hatch for the static {4} / {5} config.
